# ctables/panic

> Helper: runtime errors. Writes the message to stderr and exits with status 2.

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/panic.pkg)


  | function | message |
  |---|---|
  | `__pk_panic_index` | `panic: index out of range` |
  | `__pk_panic_len` | `panic: negative length in make` |
  | `__pk_panic_oom` | `panic: out of memory` |

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm

```

## Support code (once per program)

```nasm
static void __pk_panic(const char *m) {
write(2, m, strlen(m));
_exit(2);
}
static void __pk_panic_index(void) { __pk_panic("panic: index out of range\n"); }
static void __pk_panic_len(void) { __pk_panic("panic: negative length in make\n"); }
static void __pk_panic_oom(void) { __pk_panic("panic: out of memory\n"); }
```
